example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এত কৃপণ যে হাতের জল না গলা, কাউকে কিছু দিতে চায় না।
এই লোকটার হাতের জল না গলা, তার কাছে কোনো দানের ভাব নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so stingy that the water in his hand won't melt; he won't give anything to anyone.
That man is extremely miserly, like the water in his hand won't melt; he has no spirit of charity.
note: This idiom vividly illustrates extreme reluctance to share even the most basic resources, rooted in everyday Bengali expressions of character flaws.
